В оригинале 'требования к себе' (self-demands/high standards), в переводе 'самокритика' (self-criticism). Хотя они связаны, это разные когнитивные процессы.

reviewed.note: The translator added 'to keep them', which is not in the source and creates a logical leap not present in the original Russian.
Accurate. 'Self-criticism' is a specific psychological term, whereas the source refers to 'demands/standards' (требования).
Confirmed. The shift from the general 'person' in the source to 'myself' in the translation is a stylistic inconsistency in the example.

This is a case of conscious transcreation. 'Doesn't always deliver' is a natural, idiomatic way in English to express that something doesn't yield the expected result/fulfillment. It is not a mistake.

verdict.notes: The translation is generally high quality, but there is one critical addition of meaning in screen 2 and a minor terminological inaccuracy in the exercise section.
